sources.note: 207 entries on main at inspection; file moved here from playwright-core/src/server. viewport = layout viewport after browser UI; screen = full screen in CSS px.
Only the 8-inch main screen and 8.9 mm folded thickness rendered; the specification table did not render to a plain fetch, so panel resolution is NOT vendor-verified here.

Flex mode = FoldingFeature HALF_OPENED (POSTURE_HALF_OPENED); Samsung foldables report TYPE_FOLD; requires Jetpack WindowManager 1.0.0+. No hinge angle thresholds or screen dimensions published on the page.

State FLAT | HALF_OPENED; Orientation VERTICAL | HORIZONTAL; OcclusionType NONE (flexible screen, treat as guideline) | FULL (hinge is part of the window); isSeparating true for hinges always and for folds when not FLAT.
continuous = flat or fully closed; folded = book or laptop posture.

sources.note: Chrome 108 default interactive-widget=resizes-visual on Android; Safari iOS resizes visual viewport only; Firefox resizes both. No keyboard heights published.

display_features.derivation: portrait coordinates: centre line of the portrait inner width 984 / 2 = 492.0; width 0 and occlusion none because FoldingFeature.OcclusionType is NONE for flexible screens; actual fold bounds are unmeasured (see unknowns)

landscape coordinates (tabletop = phone held landscape, fold stays at half the portrait width): centre line of the landscape screen height 984 / 2 = 492.0; width 0 and occlusion none per FoldingFeature.OcclusionType NONE. Offset is in screen coordinates; the Playwright landscape layout viewport is smaller than the screen, so the offset relative to the layout viewport depends on where the browser UI sits (unmeasured)

unknowns.reason: Vendor panel resolutions are unverified: physical_px is css_px x deviceScaleFactor from Playwright (inner 984x1092 @2 = 1968x2184; cover 360x840 @3 = 1080x2520). The Samsung spec table did not render.

Fold bounds on hardware are unmeasured; the display features are derived centre lines in screen coordinates (vertical in portrait, horizontal in landscape, because the fold stays at half the portrait width and reads as horizontal only when the phone is held landscape). The Playwright landscape layout viewport is smaller than the screen, so the fold offset relative to the layout viewport shifts by the browser UI height (unmeasured).
Samsung publishes no hinge-angle thresholds for Flex mode.
Android density buckets per panel are unverified; dp entries assume Chromium css_px = dp.
Cover panel diagonal not verified from the vendor page.
System insets (status bar, navigation bar) and cutout geometry are not published; insets recorded as 0, meaning "not published", not "none".
No published or cited community measurement of the soft keyboard height for this device; measure at test time (visualViewport.height delta or env(keyboard-inset-height)). Never defaulted.
